svg.title: Wearable AI: upward evolution tree
svg.desc: Selected named works share a calibrated, upward year axis from 2015 to 2026. Color identifies research role. Technical-route stems are classification scaffolding, not model lineage. Pre-2015 foundations are separate and not to scale.
svg.text: Named milestones, technical routes and research roles · read upward
Selected works only · source cutoff 2026-09-02 · 2026 is a partial year
Support: datasets / cohorts · evaluation / benchmarks · infrastructure / standards
Dots mark registry years; online / issue-year distinctions remain in the XMind notes.
Branches group research roles. No line asserts inheritance, causality or the origin of a field.
